title: Donkey Kong Land
shortDescription: Donkey Kong Land is organized in GameAtlas's Game Boy family platformer collection with a source-linked record and deterministic catalog context.
highlights: Sets a direct-reference platformer marker within the Game Boy family catalog.
Uses structured metadata as provenance rather than imported review copy.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Grouped for the Game Boy family platformer discovery path using the documented Wikidata platform mapping; this remains a labeled reference path, not a popularity claim.
